real_environment: a bright 1999 Harvard elevator lobby with three brushed-steel elevator doors
scale_anchor_object: orange basketball on the lobby floor

cast.subject: student observer
others: performer in a dark furry gorilla suit

wardrobe.white_team: 1999 plain white t-shirts and blue denim jeans
wardrobe.black_team: 1999 plain black t-shirts and dark trousers
wardrobe.gorilla: full-body shaggy dark brown-black furry gorilla costume
wardrobe.observer: casual college crew-neck sweater and jeans
wardrobe.radiologist: crisp white medical coat over hospital scrubs

must_have_scenes.title: 1999 Harvard William James Hall Elevator Bay Basketball Pass & Chest-Thumping Gorilla
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Six players in white and black shirts passing basketballs in front of three grey elevator doors while a person in a gorilla suit stops in the middle and thumps its chest.

key_visual.description: the gorilla-suited mannequin stands dead centre in front of the middle elevator door thumping its chest while the six players keep passing two orange basketballs around it

must_have_scenes.title: Observer Tallying Passes at the Monitor & Replay Shock
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: The viewer insists there was no gorilla in the video, then watches the rewind and freezes in shock as the gorilla beats its chest dead center on the screen.

must_have_scenes.title: Eye-Tracking Red Crosshair Locked Directly on the Unseen Gorilla
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: A red eye-tracking crosshair sits directly on the chest-thumping gorilla for one full second while the viewer keeps counting passes.

must_have_scenes.title: Radiologist Missing a Gorilla 48x Nodule Size in a Lung CT Scan
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: A dark gorilla silhouette 48 times bigger than a nodule sits inside a lung scan as an expert doctor clicks right past it.

must_have_scenes.title: Everyday Crosswalk Selective-Attention Blindness
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Locked onto a single task on a screen, you walk right past someone waving directly in front of your face.

anatomy_descriptors.primary visual cortex: folded occipital ridge at the back of the brain

step1.function: receiving raw light signals from the eyes and forming the initial visual image at the back of the brain
step1.narration_bridge: First, light from both the players and the dark gorilla reaches your visual cortex, the vision center at the back of your brain.

step2.function: directing selective attention onto task-relevant targets while suppressing ignored visual signals
step2.narration_bridge: Next, while you count white shirts, your parietal cortex narrows its attention spotlight onto white shapes and shuts out the dark gorilla.

setup.camera: Wide eye-level establishing shot pushing into the 1999 Harvard elevator lobby
setup.environment: Three brushed-steel elevator doors line the cream wall marked with black S curves in bright daylight
setup.action: Three matte-white porcelain mannequins in white t-shirts and blue jeans weave around three mannequins in black t-shirts as each player dribbles, tosses, and catches two orange basketballs
setup.prop_change: One orange basketball bounces sharply off the grey floor while the second ball arcs cleanly between outstretched porcelain hands
setup.reaction: Every player twists its shoulders and lunges after the flying ball with total focus

symptom.camera: Medium-wide straight-on shot holding on the center of the Harvard elevator bay
symptom.environment: Bright hallway daylight illuminates the three brushed-steel elevator doors and six weaving basketball players
symptom.action: A performer mannequin in a shaggy dark gorilla suit walks in from the right, stops dead center in front of the middle elevator door, faces the camera, and thumps its chest with both furry fists
symptom.prop_change: An orange basketball bounces off the floor and flies right past the gorilla's furry shoulders
symptom.reaction: The six players never flinch, lunging and passing around the chest-beating gorilla as if it is invisible

failure.camera: Smooth lateral tracking shot across a sunlit 1999 university testing room
failure.environment: A dark-grey television monitor sits on a wooden desk beside a paper pass-count sheet in bright daylight
failure.action: A seated student observer mannequin writes on the pad and shakes its head as an experimenter mannequin presses the remote button
failure.prop_change: The television screen flickers on the dark gorilla pounding its chest, and the pen drops from the observer's fingers and rolls across the desk
failure.reaction: The observer mannequin jerks back in the chair and clutches both porcelain hands to its head

crisis.camera: Over-the-shoulder tracking shot pushing past a student mannequin toward the crowded elevator lobby
crisis.environment: In the bright Harvard elevator bay, white-shirted and black-shirted mannequins weave in front of the three steel doors
crisis.action: The student mannequin grips a metal tally counter and presses the lever each time a white-shirted player catches and throws the ball while the dark gorilla strides through
crisis.prop_change: The metal tally counter clicks and advances as the orange basketball bounces and arcs across the floor
crisis.reaction: The observer mannequin leans forward with rigid shoulders, tracking only the white shirts as the gorilla walks by

pivot.camera: Dynamic low-angle tracking shot following a white-shirted player across the bright elevator lobby
pivot.environment: Strong overhead daylight highlights the three white-shirted mannequins in front of the brushed-steel elevator doors
pivot.action: A white-shirted porcelain mannequin catches a chest pass, pivots on one foot, and throws the orange basketball to a teammate while the gorilla pounds its chest behind them
pivot.prop_change: The bright orange basketball spins through the air and snaps into the teammate's porcelain hands
pivot.reaction: The white-shirted players lean in with locked posture, chasing the ball while ignoring every dark figure

step1.camera: Macro tracking shot gliding along the visual pathway inside an architectural cross-section cutaway of a matte-white brain

step2.camera: Smooth orbit around the upper posterior cortex and occipital lobe inside the matte-white brain cutaway

step3.camera: Close-up push-in across an eye-tracking laboratory desk toward a live gaze monitor
step3.environment: A sunlit visual cognition lab features an infrared eye camera mounted below a bright display screen
step3.action: A student mannequin rests its chin on the stand and taps a tally key as a researcher mannequin leans in and taps the monitor
step3.prop_change: On the screen, a red gaze crosshair slides onto the gorilla's chest and flashes for a full second while the counter ticks upward
step3.reaction: The researcher mannequin recoils and spreads one hand as the student keeps tapping without pausing

breakthrough.camera: Medium pan from a lung scan monitor to an expert doctor mannequin in a reading room
breakthrough.environment: A radiology workstation glows in daylight with grayscale lung scans on the wide screen
breakthrough.action: A doctor mannequin in a white coat spins the scroll wheel and taps a tiny lung spot beside a dark gorilla silhouette
breakthrough.prop_change: A red marker circle flashes around the gorilla in the lung, and the stylus drops and clatters onto the desk
breakthrough.reaction: The doctor mannequin jerks back in the chair and raises both porcelain hands to its temples

conclusion.camera: Slow pull-back rising to an elevated wide shot over a sunlit city crosswalk
conclusion.environment: Morning sunlight fills a busy urban sidewalk lined with glass storefronts and a marked pedestrian crossing
conclusion.action: A pedestrian mannequin walks forward and taps rapidly on a smartphone screen while a friend mannequin waves both arms in front of it and grabs its shoulder
conclusion.prop_change: The smartphone screen flashes and a paper coffee cup in the pedestrian's hand tips and spills drops across the lid
conclusion.reaction: The pedestrian mannequin flinches, lowers the phone, and raises an open hand in startled apology

scenes.step1: Three-quarter profile of a smooth matte-white porcelain mannequin head in a bright white studio gallery with an architectural translucent cutaway cranium revealing the full realistic matte-white 3D porcelain brain with deep gyri and sulci inside the skull. Two soft warm-ivory light pulses glide inside the white-matter fiber tracts from the optic nerve into the primary visual cortex at the back of the brain, lighting the folded occipital ridge subtle warm amber-gold while the parietal cortex above glows soft pearl-ivory in bright studio daylight.
scenes.step2: Smooth orbit around the matte-white porcelain mannequin head with its translucent cutaway cranium revealing the full matte-white 3D brain in a bright white studio gallery. At the upper back of the brain, the parietal cortex glows subtle warm amber-gold and projects a focused top-down beam into the primary visual cortex. Soft warm-ivory internal light pulses for the white shirts glide forward cleanly inside the fiber tracts, while the unattended pathway meets a muted crimson-red inhibitory gate and dims quietly.
